title: Optional Values With coalesce
scenario: Variables can default to null to represent an optional value. Use coalesce() to fall back to a friendly default when the caller does not provide a nickname.
constraints: Declare nickname with a null default.
Use coalesce(var.nickname, "learner") in a local value.

focus.title: Add the fallback value
focus.todo: Use coalesce with the optional variable and a default string.
